auditor_verdict: AGREE that the data shows quota coupling: notes_capacity is exactly 32× rooms_capacity (2,621,440 at 81,920 rooms and 5,242,880 at 163,840). However, the 2,753,430 plateau is not itself a demonstrated effective limit—it exceeds the earlier 2,621,440 capacity and remains 2,489,450 below the later capacity—so enforcement behavior remains unclear.
